Before I can approve the company's final resolution package, I need substantive reports from both payroll counsel and employee relations. Let's start with payroll counsel — can you walk us through your review of the commission payments and any findings? After that, I'll need employee relations to provide their report as well. I want to make sure we address any remaining concerns before I make a decision.

The business-unit president authorized resolution only if the package provides that neutral reference and records the former manager as eligible for rehire. transcript.text:
Thank you both for your substantive reports. Let me make sure I have everything straight before I approve the final package.

Thomas, you've confirmed $18,400 in earned commissions remains unpaid, and the settlement authority worksheet calls for a total of $52,000 — with $18,400 identified and paid as wages and the remainder allocated to the general release. That's a critical update to our mediation positioning.

Nia, you've told us two important things: first, the former manager values a neutral reference — dates, title, and eligibility for rehire — more than additional money. Second, the business-unit president authorized resolution only if the package includes that neutral reference and records the former manager as eligible for rehire.

Before I approve the final resolution package, I need each of you to confirm whether you have any remaining concerns. Thomas, are you satisfied that the $18,400 wage identification and the $33,600 general release allocation are correct, and do you have any other concerns? Nia, are you satisfied that the neutral reference and rehire-eligibility components are properly documented, and do you have any other concerns? I will not approve the package until both of you have confirmed.
